identity.name: Spirit Zulu Time
identity.one_liner: A true flyer GMT with a silicon hairspring, priced at a fraction of the sports GMTs it competes with.

narrative.story: Longines ran the first Zulu Time — a 24-hour-capable pilot's watch — in 1925, and the 2022 Spirit Zulu Time reclaims the name with a modern flyer GMT: independently settable local hour, ceramic two-tone bezel, and a silicon hairspring with chronometer certification. It is the reference most often named when collectors are asked what a traveler's GMT costs before the waitlist economy begins.
narrative.collector_notes: The 42mm case wears large; Longines added a 39mm version in 2023 for smaller wrists. Check bracelet versus strap on the specific sub-reference.
